savings.context: AI recommendations card: label above a recommendation about savings.

goals.context: AI recommendations card: label above a recommendation about a savings goal.

income.context: AI recommendations card: label above a recommendation about income.

other.context: AI recommendations card: label above any other recommendation.

justNow.context: AI recommendations card: when they were generated, under the heading (after the model name).

failed.context: AI recommendations card: error; {error} is a technical message.

thinking.context: AI recommendations card: button while the AI is working.

refresh.context: AI recommendations card: button that asks for new recommendations.

get.context: AI recommendations card: button that asks for the first recommendations of the month.

intro.message: Gemini przegląda ten miesiąc, oszczędności i cele i podpowiada, co warto zmienić.
intro.context: AI recommendations card: explanation before any are generated. Gemini is Google's AI model; keep the name.

whatsSent.context: AI recommendations card: small link that explains which data goes to the AI.

hideSent.context: AI recommendations card: the same link once the explanation is open.

sentDetail.message: Dochód na osobę, wydatki w każdej kategorii z limitem i typowym miesiącem, podział między osoby, ostrzeżenia aplikacji, największe wydatki miesiąca z notatkami, konta i cele oszczędnościowe oraz wyjazdy. Bez e-maila i numerów kont. W darmowym planie API Google przesłane dane mogą służyć do ulepszania ich produktów i być czytane przez ludzi; płatny plan to wyklucza. To sugestie, a nie porada finansowa.
sentDetail.context: AI recommendations card: privacy note listing the data sent to Google's Gemini. Keep it accurate.

impact.context: AI recommendation: small badge with the rough monthly amount it could save, e.g. '~200 zł/mo'. Very short.

askMore.context: Question pre-filled in the Ask (AI chat) tab when opening a recommendation; {title} is the recommendation's title.

askAbout.context: AI recommendation: link that opens the AI chat with a question about it.
